issue_request: FHIR-15670 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 Questionnaire and requested clarification that when a parent or ancestor item is disabled by enableWhen, child items are also hidden/disabled even if their own enableWhen logic would otherwise enable them.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed FHIR-15670 commit was found, but git history shows commit 37ee370c54dfacfae4832dc5c7a51bef52968f80 (Applied Questionnaire trackers) added the exact descendant-disable sentence to the then-authoritative Questionnaire spreadsheet source. The current XML StructureDefinition carries that wording forward.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in source/fhir.ini. Later enableWhen and Questionnaire edits preserved the rule and added adjacent guidance for disabled dependency items. Corrected Zulip and Confluence searches found no community record contradicting the Jira/source outcome. A broad Jira search also surfaced FHIR-35957 in the SDC IG required-parent space, but that is outside this core Questionnaire enableWhen descendant-disable decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/questionnaire/structuredefinition-Questionnaire.xml already states in Questionnaire.item.enableWhen that when an item is disabled, all descendants are disabled regardless of their own enableWhen logic.

related_jiras.note: Appeared in broad Jira search for parent/child Questionnaire behavior, but concerns an SDC rendering profile required-parent question rather than this core enableWhen descendant-disable rule.
